about: The collecta of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that the splendor of Thy glory may shine upon us, and that the brightness of Thy light may, by the illumination of the Holy Ghost, strengthen the hearts of those who have been born again by Thy grace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
